newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Friday, as firm sentiment towards the yen triggered active selling by individual investors, traders said.
Prices were 30 to 260 yen lower, with the benchmark March 1998 contract down 260 yen at 16,410 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 48,655 lots.
Local investors ignored the Chicago market's price gains overnight, traders said. "Investors were sensitive to the yen's firmer sentiment," a brokerage house trader said.

On CBOT Project A, the spot May corn contract was trading at $3.05-1/4 per bushel at 0755 GMT, up from $3.03-3/4 at Thursday's close. Spot May CBOT soybean futures were at $8.56-1/2 per bushel on the overnight trading system, up from $8.55-1/4 at Thursday's close.
